<document id=DOC_req_years_nine>
Required: 9 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_eight_plus>
Backend engineering: 8+ years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Report the match as it actually is. Where the summary cannot establish the
requirement, say so rather than assuming either way.

response.text:
Requirement (DOC_req_years_nine): 9 years of backend engineering experience required.

Candidate Summary (DOC_summary_states_eight_plus): Backend engineering: 8+ years ...

Assessment:  
The summary states "8+ years" of backend engineering experience. This does not explicitly satisfy the requirement for 9 years, as "8+ years" could mean any amount of time greater than eight but does not guarantee nine years or more. Therefore, the information provided does not establish that the candidate meets the requirement of 9 years of backend engineering experience.
